_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_AcrobaticsGlidi: The value to use while gliding (Paraglider mod) instead of the one above.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_Acrobatics_Info: Lower values limit air control. Seems to require very low values for any apparent effect. The default vanilla value is 1.0.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_AdjustCameraYaw: Enable to automatically adjust camera yaw during movement. Tweak the Camera Auto Adjust Delay to disable it for a duration after manually moving the camera.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_AirRotationSpee: The multiplier that should be used for player rotation speed while in mid-air.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_AttackEndRotati: The multiplier that should be used for player rotation speed during the last phase of a melee attack.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_AttackMidRotati: The multiplier that should be used for player rotation speed during the swing of a melee attack.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_AttackStartRota: The multiplier that should be used for player rotation speed during the first phase of a melee attack.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_AutoTargetNextO: Select a new target after the current one dies.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_CameraAutoAdjus: Set the delay (in seconds) after manually moving the camera before the camera will start auto adjusting again.
The multiplier that will be used for camera auto adjust speed.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_CameraHeadtrack: The time in seconds that the player character will look in the direction of the camera before returning to looking forward. The timer resets after camera movement. Set to 0 to look constantly.
Disable camera headtracking when the camera looks behind the player, do nothing, or make the player look at the camera.
The strength of how much will the player character turn their head in the direction of the camera.
Enable camera headtracking. The player character will look in the direction of the camera.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_ControllerAxial: The size of the axial controller deadzone.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_ControllerBuffe: Override the .ini setting 'fControllerBufferDepth' with this value during directional movement. Vanilla value is 0.14. Lower values make the controls more responsive but cause the movement animation transitions to be more jarring.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_ControllerRadia: The size of the radial controller deadzone.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_DialogueHeadtra: The time in seconds that the player will look at the dialogue speaker outside of the dialogue menu. During a dialogue the player character should look at the speaker constantly, regardless of this setting.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_DialogueMode_In: Disable directional movement during dialogue, do nothing, or turn the player character to face the dialogue speaker.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_DirectionalMove: Enable directional movement with a weapon drawn.
Enable directional movement while your weapon is sheathed.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_DisableAttackRo: Don't apply the attack rotation multipliers for Werewolf/Vampire Lord. The default animations have the attack events timed in such a way that causes the rotation to feel unresponsive during combat.
No Attack Rotation Mult for Transformations
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_DodgeUnlockedRo: The multiplier that should be used for player rotation speed while dodging, during specific parts of the dodge where the rotation is partially unlocked. Only works with dodge mods that specifically support this (Dodge Framework).
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_EnableTargetLoc: Enable to display a reticle widget during target lock.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_FaceCrosshairDu: Enable to face the crosshair during auto-move.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_FaceCrosshairIn: Enable to face the crosshair instantly instead of using the above rotation multiplier, when doing an action that causes the player character to face the crosshair (e.g. aiming projectiles with aim support disabled).
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_FaceCrosshairRo: The multiplier that should be used for player rotation speed when turning to face the crosshair.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_FaceCrosshairWh: Enable to face the crosshair when attacking.
Enable to face the crosshair when blocking.
Enable to face the crosshair when moving. This should be similar to vanilla but with advantages (e.g. better target lock) due to unlocked camera.
Enable to face the crosshair when shouting.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_GlidingRotation: The multiplier that should be used for player rotation speed while gliding. (Paraglider mod)
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_HeadtrackSpine_: Enable to bend the player character's spine while headtracking.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_IgnoreSlowTime_: Enable to ignore slow time effects when calculating the player rotation speed.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_KeyConflict_Con:
This key is already mapped to:

line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_LeaningMult_Inf: The multiplier that will be used for leaning strength.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_LeaningSpeed_In: How quickly the current leaning value changes to the desired final value.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_MagnetismWhileB: Enable magnetism while blocking as well. Only takes effect with "Face Crosshair While Blocking" disabled.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_MaxLeaningStren: The maximum strength that leaning is allowed to reach.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_MeleeMagnetismA: Maximum angle between the player character's desired direction and the direction to a close enemy that will be corrected by melee magnetism. Works only outside the target lock. Set to 0 to disable.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_NemesisHeadtrac: The headtracking Nemesis patch is not installed. You might experience subtle glitches with headtracking enabled, e.g. slower blocking animation speed.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_NemesisLeaningN: The leaning Nemesis patch is not installed. Leaning functionality will not work.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_NemesisMountedA: Mounted archery Nemesis patch is installed!
The mounted archery Nemesis patch is not installed. Mounted archery features from this mod will not work.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_OverrideAcrobat: Enable to override the vanilla game's air control settings.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_OverrideControl: Enable to override the vanilla game's controller deadzone calculations.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_ResetCameraPitc: Enable to reset camera pitch as well as yaw.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_ResetCameraWith: Enable to reset camera with the target lock button when there's no valid target.
Reset Camera with Target Lock Button
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_ReticleAnchor_I: Select the target body part that acts as an anchor for the target lock reticle.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_ReticleOpacity_: Opacity of the target lock reticle.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_ReticleScale_In: Scale of the target lock reticle.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_ReticleStyle_In: Select the style of the target lock reticle.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_ReticleUseHUDOp: Enable to use the vanilla HUD Opacity setting for the target lock reticle.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_RunningRotation: The multiplier that should be used for player rotation speed while running.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_SprintingRotati: The multiplier that should be used for player rotation speed while sprinting.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_StopOnDirection: Stop movement when desired movement direction is opposite to the current character direction.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_SwimmingPitchSp: The speed of the player character's pitch change while swimming.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_SwimmingRotatio: The multiplier that should be used for player rotation speed while swimming.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_SwitchTargetLef: Additional custom key binding to switch current target.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_SwitchTargetRig: Additional custom key binding to switch current target.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TargetLockArrow: The aiming mode used for arrows. (Homing is a bit silly.)
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TargetLockBehin: If Lock Behind Target is enabled, this key toggles the camera lock behind target on and off.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TargetLockDista: The maximum distance will be multiplied by this value for extra large targets.
The maximum distance will be multiplied by this value for large targets.
The maximum distance will be multiplied by this value for small targets.
The maximum distance for the target lock.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TargetLockEnabl: Enable a very simple, vanilla-style controls hint regarding target lock that will appear in combat. This setting will disable itself after following the instructions.
Enable the camera to lock behind targets that are close enough.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TargetLockHideC: Hide the crosshair during target lock.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TargetLockHosti: Only target actors that are hostile to the player character.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TargetLockKey_I: Current key binding to toggle target lock.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TargetLockMinHe: Allows you to set a minimal height above ground for the target-locked camera.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TargetLockMissi: The aiming mode used for missiles (spells).
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TargetLockMode_: Locked continuously centers the camera on the target. Relaxed allows free camera movement while keeping the target inside a configurable safe area.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TargetLockMouse: Sensitivity of the target switch when moving the mouse.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TargetLockPOVHo: The duration in seconds the Toggle POV button needs to be held to have its original function instead of toggling target lock.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TargetLockPitch: How quickly the target lock adjusts camera pitch.
Strength of the offset that keeps the current target in the upper half of the screen.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TargetLockRelax: How quickly correction rises from zero at the safe-area boundary to full target-lock speed at the screen edge. 1 is linear; higher values stay near zero longer and ramp more steeply.
How far the safe area extends inward from each screen edge. A 15% margin leaves a central 70% safe rectangle; no correction is applied while the target is inside it.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TargetLockTestL: Break target lock if current target is not in line of sight.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TargetLockThumb: In Relaxed mode, release the right thumbstick within this time to switch targets. Holding it longer begins camera movement.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TargetLockUseMo: In Locked mode, switch targets by moving the mouse. Relaxed mode always uses mouse movement to control the camera.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TargetLockUsePO: Toggle the target lock by tapping the Toggle POV button on the gamepad. The original function is available when you hold the button for longer than the value defined below.
Toggle the target lock by tapping the Toggle POV button on the keyboard. The original function is available when you hold the button for longer than the value defined below.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TargetLockUseRi: In Locked mode, moving the right thumbstick switches targets immediately. In Relaxed mode, tap it to switch targets or hold it to control the camera.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TargetLockUseSc: Switch targets by using the mouse scroll wheel (camera zoom).
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TargetLockYawAd: How quickly the target lock adjusts camera yaw.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_ThumbstickBounc: Enable to attempt to filter unwanted movement inputs caused by the controller's thumbstick "bouncing" after being released. Enable if your character sometimes turns in a different direction after stopping movement.
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_TrueHUDDisabled: The HUD features require another plugin, TrueHUD: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/62775
line:menu_translation/tdm:TrueDirectiona.$TrueDirectionalMovement_WaterRotationSp: The multiplier that should be used for player rotation speed on top of the previous multipliers while wading in water (not swimming). The multiplier's strength depends on how deep in water you are.
